title: Acridocarpus orientalis ethanolic extract induces senescence and abortive autophagy in human breast cancer cells
task: Investigate anti-cancer mechanisms of Acridocarpus orientalis extract against triple-negative breast cancer
key_results: AOEE inhibited cell proliferation in concentration- and time-dependent manner; induced G1/S cell cycle arrest with upregulation of p21WAF1 and p27Kip1; induced p16-dependent senescence and abortive autophagy in MDA-MB-231 cells
comments: The induction of both senescence and abortive (incomplete) autophagy is interesting but the relative contribution of each pathway to growth inhibition remains unclear.

model_io.model: TNBC cell lines (MDA-MB-231, Hs578T) and luminal A cell line (MCF-7)

hypotheses.hypothesis: AOEE induces cell cycle arrest through CDK inhibitor upregulation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed by increased p21WAF1 and p27Kip1 with decreased Cyclin D1 and phospho-Rb

hypotheses.hypothesis: AOEE induces senescence in TNBC cells
hypotheses.result: Confirmed by p16-dependent senescence and SA-β-gal expression in MDA-MB-231 cells

hypotheses.hypothesis: ERK and p38 pathways mediate autophagy and senescence induction
hypotheses.result: AOEE activated both ERK and p38 pathways

title: NuSAP1 promotes spindle assembly in Trypanosoma brucei by bundling spindle microtubules
task: Elucidate the mechanistic role of NuSAP1 in spindle assembly and mitotic regulation in Trypanosoma brucei
key_results: NuSAP1 bundles microtubules in vitro; NuSAP1 depletion disrupts spindle assembly and kinetochore biorientation; NuSAP1 regulates NuSAP4 stability and SPB1 localization through distinct structural motifs
comments: This work reveals an unusual spindle assembly mechanism specific to a parasitic eukaryote, with potential implications for understanding divergent mitotic regulation strategies.

model_io.model: Trypanosoma brucei cells with NuSAP1 knockdown

hypotheses.hypothesis: NuSAP1 functions as a microtubule-bundling protein required for spindle assembly
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: NuSAP1 bundles microtubules in vitro; depletion disrupts spindle assembly

hypotheses.hypothesis: NuSAP1 is required for spindle pole complex formation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: NuSAP1 knockdown disrupts MAP103 and TbMlp2 localization to spindle poles

hypotheses.hypothesis: NuSAP1 regulates protein stability and localization through protein-protein interactions
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: NuSAP1 stabilizes NuSAP4 and regulates SPB1 localization through distinct motifs

title: A data-driven framework for long-term risk stratification of advanced Parkinson’s disease using PPMI
task: Long-term risk stratification of advanced Parkinson's disease using clinical and genetic features
key_results: Year-9 prediction model achieves AUROC 0.89 (95% CI 0.81-0.97) in PPMI cohort; independent validation shows attenuation (AUROC 0.55-0.61) due to dataset shift
comments: Well-designed longitudinal study with explicit separation of forecasting from contemporaneous staging, but substantial performance loss in external validation highlights generalization challenges.

model_io.model: Forecasting pipeline for advanced Parkinson's disease

hypotheses.hypothesis: Baseline clinical and genetic features can predict advanced Parkinson's disease at 7-11 year horizon
hypotheses.result: AUROC 0.89 in primary cohort (n=1,302); AUROC 0.55-0.61 in independent cohort (n=35)

title: Automatic prediction of cotton leaf’s diseases using deep learning techniques
task: Automated detection of cotton leaf diseases using transfer learning CNN
key_results: CLDP-CNN achieves 99.78% accuracy on primary field dataset and 99.62% on secondary Kaggle dataset; VGG16 transfer learning baseline achieves 99.56% and 98.82% respectively
comments: High reported accuracies suggest potential overfitting or dataset bias; generalization to truly novel field conditions not thoroughly validated.

model_io.model: CLDP-CNN (Cotton Leaf Disease Prediction CNN) with transfer learning
inputs: Cotton leaf images from field and Kaggle datasets
outputs: Disease classification (Bacterial Blight, Fusarium Wilt, Curl Virus Disease)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Transfer learning-based CNN with optimized preprocessing improves cotton leaf disease classification on field images
hypotheses.result: CLDP-CNN: 99.78% on primary dataset; VGG16: 99.56% on primary dataset

title: Automated enhancement of post-infectious lung CT images using multi-technique noise detection and denoising with quantitative evaluation
task: Automated noise detection and denoising of post-infectious lung CT images
key_results: BM3D denoising with automated noise detection improves image quality; significant enhancement in PSNR, SSIM, and edge preservation metrics
comments: Image enhancement preprocessing for clinical applications, but quantitative performance metrics (exact PSNR/SSIM values) are not provided in the abstract.

model_io.model: Deep ensemble learning with BM3D denoising
outputs: Denoised CT images with improved quality metrics

model_io.model: Multi-technique noise detection (Blur Laplacian, Noise Entropy, Noise Power Spectrum Density, Wavelet Transform)
outputs: Numeric variance per noise type; automatic noise type classification

title: Improving arrhythmic risk prediction using cardiac magnetic resonance within deep learning in ischemic heart disease
task: Improve arrhythmic risk prediction in ischemic heart disease using LGE-CMR with deep learning
key_results: Scar entropy is consistent strong predictor of major arrhythmic events; DeepSurv outperforms Cox regression with superior cross-cohort generalization; Random Survival Forests robust in pooled analysis
comments: Well-designed comparative study of survival models, but the modest event counts (54 and 50 events across two cohorts) may limit model stability and validation strength.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Scar heterogeneity (entropy) measured by LGE-CMR improves arrhythmic risk prediction beyond conventional markers
hypotheses.result: Scar entropy consistently emerged as strong predictor; non-linear models outperformed Cox regression

hypotheses.hypothesis: Machine learning survival models achieve better cross-cohort generalization than Cox regression
hypotheses.result: DeepSurv demonstrated superior generalization across independent cohorts; Random Survival Forests robust in pooled analysis

title: Topological approaches to quantum tensor train compression via ZX-calculus and SVD
task: Compress quantum tensor networks via ZX-calculus and SVD
key_results: Algebraically collapses bond dimension χ without information loss; bypasses O(χ³) bottlenecks with computational speedup
comments: Elegant integration of categorical quantum mechanics with numerical methods, though practical scalability beyond stabilizer states remains unclear.

hypotheses.hypothesis: ZX-driven algebraic erasure can collapse effective bond dimension without numerical approximation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; algebraic symmetries enable information-lossless compression

title: Detection of underground objects from GPR data using a lightweight YOLO-based approach
task: Detect small subsurface objects in GPR radargrams
key_results: YOLOv8n with GhostConv achieves 5.7% mAP and 5.9% F1-score improvement on integrated dataset; reduced inference time
comments: Lightweight architecture addressing practical real-time constraints; marginal gains from ghost modules suggest data quality or noise remains limiting.

hypotheses.hypothesis: GhostConv+C3Ghost modules enhance feature extraction in noisy GPR data
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 5.7% mAP improvement, reduced computational cost

title: Reliable estimation of the confined compressive strength of FRP-confined circular concrete columns using an ANFIS-based model
task: Predict confined compressive strength of FRP-confined concrete columns
key_results: ANFIS model outperforms five analytical confinement equations; 812 experimental samples; superior predictive consistency with reduced scatter
comments: Well-executed ANFIS application with comprehensive literature database; physical input interpretability strong but generalization beyond FRP systems untested.

hypotheses.hypothesis: ANFIS provides more reliable estimates than analytical confinement models
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; superior consistency and reduced scatter across 812 experimental results

title: Centrifugal pump analysis and prediction in cavitation using RapidMiner tool and machine learning algorithms
task: Predict cavitation onset in centrifugal pumps
key_results: Fine Tree algorithm achieves 96.1% accuracy; Naive Bayes 95.5%; maximum vapor fraction 0.9477 at impeller water-moving part
comments: Standard ML pipeline with CFD preprocessing; limited novelty in algorithms but practical industrial application value.

hypotheses.hypothesis: CFD-derived NPSHa/NPSHr ratio predicts cavitation onset

title: Integrated continuous berth allocation with time-invariant specific quay crane assignment using a mixed-integer model and greedy genetic algorithm
task: Integrated berth allocation and specific quay crane assignment
key_results: Greedy genetic algorithm obtains high-quality feasible schedules within practical times; repair mechanism provides most significant gain in solution quality
comments: Realistic operational constraints and real port data strengthen validation; repair heuristic likely domain-specific and transferability unclear.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Greedy initialization and repair operations reduce infeasibility
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; repair mechanism provides most improvement in stability and average quality

title: Learning risk matrix from textual data through graph neural networks
task: Construct risk matrices from textual incident data with limited labels
key_results: RMGNN achieves 81% accuracy and 74% F1-score with only 5% labeled data; reduces expert annotation by 95%; enables cross-domain knowledge transfer
comments: Clever semi-supervised approach leveraging graph structure; real-world impact via annotation cost reduction is significant, though F1 remains moderate.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Graph centrality estimates event probability; label propagation predicts severity
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 81% accuracy with 95% fewer labeled examples than baselines

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cross-domain knowledge transfer generalizes to related domains
hypotheses.result: Supported; enables risk assessment with limited historical data in new domains
